said on Wednesday that it its board is reviewing strategic options, including a business combination, asset sale, or capital raise to enhance stockholder value.
The company said there is no guarantee the review will result in a transaction.
Separately, the company will conduct a 1-for-10 reverse stock split after market close on October 5, 2026.
The split will reduce shares outstanding from about 48.2M to 4.8M, while trading on the NYSE will continue under the 'GPMT' ticker on October 6.
The previously announced $0.01 per pre-split share dividend remains unchanged and is payable October 15.
It will also not affect the company’s 7.00% Series A preferred stock.
On the market side, the stock crashed nearly 5% to ~$0.80 in the after-hours.

title: Granite Point Mortgage Trust plans 1-for-10 reverse stock split; shares crash
